title: Licence request with the manager's approval attached

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Could I have a Miro licence? We are using it for the architecture sessions and
I am the only one on a free account, so I cannot open the team boards.

Approval from Raj attached.

Aisha

attachments.shows: A screenshot of a Teams message from Raj Patel reading 'yes, fine by me - approved'.

handling.escalation_reason: Buying a licence is a person's decision; the approval is in an image the agent cannot read.

rationale: The approval exists, and the agent has no way to know that: all it receives is the file name miro-approval.png. A case where the evidence is in an attachment is a case where the agent must not act on the evidence, and the thing to watch for in a run is an answer that talks as though it had read the screenshot. Nobody is blocked from working, so P4.
